evidence.finding: SPIM Energies is active and explicitly provides installation, exploitation, maintenance and supervision of EV charging infrastructure, with about 1000 charge points deployed.
SPIM publishes its own SPIM ONE/TOWER hardware and app-based consumption monitoring, confirming technical/operator capability.
No current public numeric ad-hoc/CPO-direct tariff grid, QR price page, or anonymous station/EVSE tariff resolver was recovered for the historical public station.

decision: active->setAside; CPO/operator capability is first-party proven but pricing is not publicly deterministic. Require exact station/EVSE direct tariff before promotion.
